messages:
maria: FYI customers in us-west-2 are seeing spikes of 503s since ~12:13 UTC. Upstream inference workers are repeatedly exiting (exit codes 137/139) during toolcall path. Short sample in logs shows SIGSEGV and CUDA OOM. Any quick ideas?

ajay: I see the same in infra — infer-pool-3 restart rate jumped ~+20/min around 12:13. Attaching pod logs (snippet below).

maria: logs: 
```
2026-03-16T12:13:22Z infer_runner[pid=1234] ERROR: SIGSEGV (core dumped)
stacktrace: 0x7ff... at kv_prefetch.cpp:412
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2GB for KV cache
2026-03-16T12:13:22Z infer_runner[pid=1234] INFO: exiting with code 139
```

olga: CS triage — 3 customers reported timeouts and one observed an SSO auth failure as a downstream symptom (token retry loop) but root seems upstream 503s, not auth. Customers hit repeated retries so billing noise too.

kevin: confirmed not an auth token issue; the retries amplify billing. Mitigation plan: fallback routing to a smaller model variant or CPU-path for toolcall-heavy requests while we stabilize.

sam: quick mitigation options: disable prefetch for toolcall route and revert recent dynbatch tweak. Example fallback config we can flip: 
```json
{"fallback_policy": {"prefer": "cpu-small", "max_retries": 2}}
```

ajay: can also patch config to disable prefetch globally for the pool: 
```
kubectl patch cm infer-config -n hosted --patch '{"data":{"enable_prefetch":"false"}}'
```
I can roll it now.

maria: applying patch to infer-pool-3, initiating rolling restart on that pool.

sre-bot: deploy job started: patch applied to ConfigMap infer-config in namespace hosted. RollingUpdate on deployment infer-runner-infer-pool-3 triggered.

ajay: metrics update: restart rate down to +3/min after 3 minutes. OOMs much reduced but a few segfaults persist on large toolcall payloads.

ajay: repro steps we've used: run loadgen with toolcall payload that includes long context + embedded tool call. This reliably triggers prefetch allocation path.

maria: reproduction command for engineering: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-7b-quant","input":"<long prompt ~50k chars>","tool_call":true,"batch_size":8}'
```

olga: CS update: customers notified, tickets opened, offered one-off credits for retries. Awaiting confirmation if issue resolved for them.

sam: next engineering actions: collect core dumps/minidumps from crashed pods, enable nv_profiling temporarily, and implement a per-request KV-cache cap to avoid huge single-request allocations. Propose hotfix to enforce cap = 512MB for quant models.

kevin: also recommend temporary tighter rate-limits on toolcall endpoints for hosted tier while we roll the hotfix — reduces blast radius and billing churn.

maria: thanks — assigning incident lead to ajay. Moving to dedicated incident channel for deeper triage and RCA. Will keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
